versions.changelog:
Initial release of the aiXplain Agent Builder skill.

- Design, deploy, run, and manage aiXplain agents
- Connect and create tools, including Slack, Gmail, Supabase, SQLite, and 600+ more
- Ground agents with your data by indexing files and text in Qdrant
- Connect agents to databases and structured sources for live data access
- Choose from 140+ models accessible through aiXplain’s API key
- Support planning, tool search, and tool creation
- Debug agents with step-by-step traces and execution stats
- Open agents in aiXplain Studio for visual editing and analytics
- Include setup, workflow, and reference documentation
